levels.surface: أحمد بن محمد بن يحيى العطار

notes: «وبهذا الاسناد» is replaced by the whole chain of prev1 (report 2, which writes its chain); no separate back_reference is written.
«قال: قال رسول الله» : the Prophet is the saying's speaker; the chain ends at the Companion Jabir.
«محمد بن علي الباقر» is named inside the chain after «حدثني», so it stays a narrator, not imam_in_text.
